entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

Hi Sarah... I'm calling because I need to return something. It's a helmet I bought a while back. I just... I'm so disappointed. I've been a loyal customer for years and I really needed this to work out.

I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just a preference, I guess. The color... it just didn't look like it did on the website. I was so excited for it, but when it arrived, my heart just sank. The box is still unopened; I haven't even touched it. I was just hoping I could get the money back, especially with the holidays coming up.
I completely understand how frustrating it can be when a color isn't what you expected. Let me pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic helmet. It looks like it was delivered to you 54 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I knew it was a while ago... I just feel terrible about it. I hope it's not too late.

Not at all! I have good news for you. That helmet is a standard item, which falls under our 90-day return policy. Since it's only been 54 days, you are well within the window to make a return for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Of course. I've just initiated the return process. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Since the box is unopened, just attach that label and drop it off. We always ask customers to make sure the helmet is packed securely to maintain its safety integrity during transit. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll process your refund.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've really helped me out today.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
